Bapuji reminds Jethalal of his promise to gift Gogi a new smartphone if he scores well. Jethalal calls Nattu Kaka at Gada Electronics to urgently dispatch a phone, leading to an exasperating comedic argument over billing, customer credit terms, and out-of-stock color choices.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
